title: Higgsfield Masters Class
description: A full Higgsfield apprenticeship: motion briefs, prompt craft for AI video, style locking, iteration loops, export discipline, and shipping short-form motion pieces end to end.

lessons.title: Higgsfield in the Creative Pipeline

introduction.text: Higgsfield sits in the AI motion layer: turn briefs into clips you can iterate and export. Treat generations as footage options, not final films. Your apprenticeship builds end-to-end motion craft—brief, generate, select, refine, and package for CapCut or social.

lessons.title: Motion Briefs that Constrain Chaos

introduction.text: A motion brief specifies subject, action, camera, mood, duration intent, and do-nots. Ambiguity burns generations. Include reference stills or adjectives that lock style. Write acceptance checks: what must be true to keep a take.

questions.question: Duration intent matters because:
options: All clips are identical length needs
Edit plans depend on usable beat length
questions.correctAnswer: Edit plans depend on usable beat length

lessons.title: Prompt Craft for Coherent Motion

introduction.text: Prompt for coherent motion: stable subject, clear verb, lighting, lens feel, and fewer conflicting styles. Iterate one variable at a time. Save prompt versions that worked. Negative constraints matter as much as positives.

Negative constraints help by:
options: Steering away from known failure modes
questions.correctAnswer: Steering away from known failure modes

lessons.title: Style Locking and Continuity

introduction.text: Campaigns need continuity across clips: palette, lens, subject identity, and motion energy. Lock style early. Build a look bible. When continuity breaks, fix with constrained regenerations rather than random new aesthetics.

questions.question: Constrained regenerations mean:
options: Changing few variables to repair continuity
questions.correctAnswer: Changing few variables to repair continuity

project.title: Look Bible + Pair Test

questions.question: Repair plans beat:
options: Throwing away the campaign look casually
questions.correctAnswer: Throwing away the campaign look casually

questions.question: Multi-clip sets fail when:

lessons.title: Selection, Iteration, and Cost Control

introduction.text: Selection is a creative skill: pick for editability, not just wow frames. Kill early. Batch similar experiments. Track what burned credits without learning. Iteration is scheduled, not infinite scroll.

questions.question: Editability means:
options: Clips that cut into a sequence cleanly
questions.correctAnswer: Clips that cut into a sequence cleanly

lessons.title: Export, Handoff, and Short-Form Packaging

introduction.text: Export with naming, aspect ratio, and duration notes editors need. Package selects with brief + look bible. Plan how clips enter CapCut timelines. Masters Higgsfield work ends when another teammate can assemble without guessing.

questions.question: Handoff packages should include:
options: Selects, brief, look notes, and naming
questions.correctAnswer: Selects, brief, look notes, and naming
